fullAccess.title: Full access — permanent, no approvals
fullAccess.body: The agent does everything itself, including deleting files, pushing to GitHub and running commands: it may use every enabled tool (also ones you add later) and needs no approvals. Everything is recorded in the audit log; you can switch it off at any time.
fullAccess.stillApplies: Still in force: «Stop everything», budgets, step and time limits, the sandbox, tools you switched off and MCP tools you have not enabled.
fullAccess.exceptions: Exceptions for this agent are under «Tools»: «block» or «always ask» for a single tool. Colleagues it asks for help act under their own settings; agents the Orchestrator creates get full access only when it is on for all agents (Settings → Agents).
fullAccess.passwordHint: Needed to turn full access on. A wrong password counts as a failed sign-in.
fullAccess.badgeHint: Does everything itself, without approvals; everything is recorded in the audit log.
fullAccess.levelPaused: While full access is on, the level below does not apply. It comes back when you switch full access off.
fullAccess.afterCreate: Full access (no approvals) can be turned on once the agent is created.
fullAccess.allToolsHint: Full access: the agent may use every enabled tool, including ones added later. On the right you can block a tool or always be asked before it.

standing.title: Allowed without asking
standing.hint: You chose “Approve and don't ask again” — the agent does these without your approval.

fullAccessAll.title: Full access for all agents
fullAccessAll.body: Every agent of the office does everything itself, without approvals: commands, files, GitHub, the internet. New agents — yours and the ones the Orchestrator creates — get full access right away. Everything is logged.
fullAccessAll.exceptions: An exception for one agent is on its page under «Tools»: «block» or «always ask» for a tool.
fullAccessAll.off: Off: agents ask for permission according to their autonomy level.
fullAccessAll.onSince: On since {date}. Agents no longer ask for permission.
fullAccessAll.confirmOff: Turn full access off for every agent? They will ask for permission again — also the ones you gave it to one by one.
fullAccessAll.pending: Actions already waiting for approval stay in their tasks — approve them once.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Important agent actions wait for your decision. An approval covers only that one action.
approvals.label: Approval request: {action}
approvals.cancelConfirm: Cancel the whole task? The agent will stop.
approvals.onlyThis: The approval covers only this action with these parameters.

fs_write.consequences: The file is created, or its current content is replaced.

fs_append.consequences: Text is added to the end of the file.

fs_move.consequences: If the destination exists and replacing is allowed, its old content is lost.

fs_delete.consequences: The file (or folder) is deleted permanently.

terminal_run.consequences: The command may create, change or delete files in the task folder (sandbox, no network).

github_create_branch.consequences: A new branch appears in the repository. Nothing else changes.

github_write_file.consequences: A commit is pushed to this branch (visible to everyone with access).

github_create_pull_request.consequences: A pull request is published under your account; people watching the repository are notified.

memory_save.consequences: The note is added to the agent's memory and used in its future tasks.

browser_screenshot.consequences: The site is loaded from the internet (it may run its scripts) in an isolated browser; a screenshot is saved in the workspace.

agent_ask.consequences: Agent {agent} gets a task and spends its own steps and budget. Its own rules and approvals apply.

agent_tell.consequences: Agent {agent} receives the message (and files, if any) and reads it on its next run.

terminal_run_packages.consequences: The command may download packages from the npm and PyPI registries only (the rest of the internet stays closed) and run their install scripts in the sandbox; it may create, change or delete files in the task folder.

github_checkout.summary: Download {repo} ({ref, select, default {default branch} other {{ref}}}) into the folder {folder}/
github_checkout.consequences: The repository's files are written into this new folder of the task. Nothing changes on GitHub.

github_checkout_overwrite.summary: Download {repo} ({ref, select, default {default branch} other {{ref}}}) into {folder}/, replacing files
github_checkout_overwrite.consequences: Files in this folder with the same path are replaced by the repository's; their current content is lost. Other files stay. Nothing changes on GitHub.

github_commit_files.consequences: One commit with these files is pushed to this branch (it is created if it does not exist) and is visible to everyone with access.

reasons.override: You asked to approve every use of this tool.
reasons.write: Changes need approval at this agent's autonomy level.

approvals.noneHint: When an agent wants to do something important (delete a file, open a pull request), the request appears here and you get a notification.

always.hint: “Don't ask again” — the agent may then {what} without asking.
always.confirm: {agent} may {what} without your approval — from now on, for good?
always.confirmHint: This also approves the current action. You can take it back on the agent's page, under “Allowed without asking”.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Everything agents can do. A tool switched off here is off for everyone; a tool switched on works only for agents you allowed it to. Actions marked “change” and “important” may need your approval.

names.browser_screenshot: Open a website in the browser

hints.fs_delete: Deletes a file or folder — only with your approval.
hints.terminal_run: Runs one command (python, node, npm, git…) in a locked sandbox without internet; package downloads (npm, PyPI) only with your approval.
hints.web_fetch: Opens a public web page and reads its text.
hints.web_search: Searches the web through your SearXNG.
hints.github_list_repos: Sees the repositories the token can access.
hints.github_list_dir: Looks inside a folder of a repository.
hints.github_read_file: Reads a file from a repository.
hints.github_list_issues: Reads the issue list of a repository.
hints.github_get_issue: Reads one issue with its comments.
hints.github_list_commits: Looks at the latest commits of a branch.
hints.github_write_file: Commits a file to a branch; to the default branch only with approval.
hints.github_create_pull_request: Opens a pull request — always with your approval.
hints.memory_save: Saves a short note to its own memory for later.
hints.browser_screenshot: Opens a site in a real browser and takes a screenshot — always with approval.
hints.knowledge_search: Searches its memory and task files by meaning.
hints.agents_list: Sees which agents it may contact and who is free right now.
hints.agent_ask: Asks another agent a question or hands it part of the work, and waits for the answer.
hints.agent_tell: Leaves another agent a note (and files); it reads it at the start of its next task.
hints.work_search: Searches finished tasks of all agents, their messages and your chats — to check what has been done.
hints.work_read: Reads one task in full (request, result, subtasks, actions, files), a message or a chat.
hints.github_checkout: Downloads a whole repository into the work folder in one step.
hints.github_commit_files: Commits many files to a branch as one commit — always with your approval.

github.description: Agents read repositories, issues and history, download a repository into their folder, create branches and commits. Commits of several files, commits to the default branch and pull requests need your approval.
github.tokenHint: Create a fine-grained token at github.com → Settings → Developer settings, only for the repositories you need, with Contents and Pull requests: Read and write (with read-only access agents can read but not commit). Stored encrypted, never sent back to the browser.
github.reposHint: One owner/repo per line. Empty = everything the token can access.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: A daily copy of the database and agents' files, a weekly restore check.
backups.howto: Back up now: infrastructure/scripts/backup-now.sh --check. Restoring: docs/deployment.md, section on backups.

warnings.no_backup_yet: No backup yet — the first one runs soon.
warnings.last_backup_failed: The last backup failed. See docker compose logs backup.
warnings.backup_too_old: The last backup is older than a day and a half.
warnings.restore_drill_failed: The restore check failed — backups may be unusable.
warnings.same_disk: Backups are on the same disk as the data and there is no off-site copy. That is no protection: set up copies off the laptop (below).

offsite.title: Copies off the laptop
offsite.description: Every daily backup also leaves the laptop, encrypted (restic), for cloud storage or an external disk. Once a week the repository is checked and a test restore is made from it.

state.protected: Protected: a recent copy off the laptop
state.off: Backups live on this laptop only

offsite.offExplain: If the laptop breaks, is lost or its disk fails, every backup goes with it. Set up copies off the laptop — three steps:

steps.storage: Create a bucket in Backblaze B2 or Cloudflare R2 (or plug an external USB disk into the server).
steps.env: Put the storage address and keys (OFFSITE_*) into the .env file on the server.

offsite.docs: Step by step, and restoring on a new computer: docs/deployment.md, section 6a.
offsite.keep: one per day — {daily}, per week — {weekly}, per month — {monthly}
offsite.checkOk: no errors ({subset} of the data read)
offsite.drillOkSame: restore works, identical to the local copy
offsite.howto: Send a copy now and check it: infrastructure/scripts/backup-now.sh --offsite --check. List copies and restore: infrastructure/scripts/offsite-restore.sh.

warnings.offsite_no_copy_yet: No off-site copy yet — the first one leaves after the next daily backup (or run offsite-init.sh).
warnings.offsite_too_old: The last off-site copy is older than two days.
warnings.offsite_check_failed: The repository check found errors — the off-site copies may be damaged.
warnings.offsite_drill_failed: The test restore from the off-site copy failed.

errors.wrong_password: OFFSITE_PASSWORD does not open the repository.
errors.no_password: OFFSITE_PASSWORD is not set: run infrastructure/scripts/offsite-init.sh.
errors.disk_missing: The external disk is not connected. Plug it in, then run docker compose restart backup.
errors.bad_settings: A mistake in the OFFSITE_* settings in .env.
errors.locked: Another restic run holds the repository — it is retried within the hour.
errors.no_local_backup: No good local backup — nothing to send.
errors.incomplete: Some files could not be read.
errors.forget_failed: The copy was sent, but old copies were not removed.
errors.interrupted: Interrupted (the service restarted) — it is retried within the hour.
errors.corrupt: The agents' files archive in the copy is damaged.
errors.no_snapshot: There are no copies in the repository yet.
errors.failed: Failed — details below and in docker compose logs backup. It is retried within the hour.
